@gen function mortality(mode::Symbol)
    cancer   = ({:cancer} ~ bernoulli(0.00001))
    cold     = ({:cold} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
    d_cancer = ({:d_cancer} ~ bernoulli(0.9))
    d_cold   = ({:d_cold} ~ bernoulli(0.00006))
    d_other  = ({:d_other} ~ bernoulli(0.000000001))
    death = (cancer && d_cancer) || (cold && d_cold) || d_other
    if mode == :death
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli(death ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    elseif mode == :death_cold
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli((death && cold) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    elseif mode == :death_nocold
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli((death && !cold) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    end
    return cancer
end

)

@gen function cough(force_lung::Bool, cond_lung::Bool)
    lung = force_lung ? true : ({:lc} ~ bernoulli(0.01))
    if cond_lung; {:cond} ~ bernoulli(lung ? 1.0 : 0.0); end
    cold = ({:cold} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
    cc = ({:cc} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cl = ({:cl} ~ bernoulli(0.3))
    return (cold && cc) || (lung && cl)
end

ANSWER = Dict(
  "original"     => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(cough, (false,false), choicemap(), g_full)),
  "intervention" => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(cough, (true,false),  choicemap(), g_int)),
  "conditioning" => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(cough, (false,true), choicemap((:cond,true)), g_full)),
)

@gen function cancer_cough(observe_cough::Bool)
    lc   = ({:lc} ~ bernoulli(0.01))
    cold = ({:cold} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
    cc   = ({:cc} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cl   = ({:cl} ~ bernoulli(0.3))
    cough = (cold && cc) || (lc && cl)
    if observe_cough
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli(cough ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    end
    return lc
end
grid = choice_vol_grid((:lc, [false, true]), (:cold, [false, true]),
                       (:cc, [false, true]), (:cl, [false, true]))
# do(cough=true) severs cough from its causes, so the marginal over lung cancer
# is unchanged from the prior: original and intervention coincide.
prior = __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(cancer_cough, (false,), choicemap(), grid))
ANSWER = Dict(
  "original"     => prior,
  "intervention" => prior,
  "conditioning" => __pplgym_enum_dist(
      enumerative_inference(cancer_cough, (true,), choicemap((:obs, true)), grid)),
)

@gen function monty(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    m     = ({:m} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    {:c1} ~ bernoulli(m != prize ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    {:c2} ~ bernoulli(m != alice ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    final = switches ? (6 - alice - m) : alice
    return final == prize
end
obs = choicemap((:c1, true), (:c2, true))
grid = choice_vol_grid((:a, [1,2,3]), (:p, [1,2,3]), (:m, [1,2,3]))
ANSWER = Dict(
  "stay"   => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(monty, (false,), obs, grid)),
  "switch" => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(monty, (true,),  obs, grid)),
)

@gen function monty_deliberate(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    tie   = ({:tie} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    remaining = [d for d in 1:3 if d != alice && d != prize]
    m = length(remaining) == 1 ? remaining[1] : (tie ? remaining[1] : remaining[2])
    final = switches ? (6 - alice - m) : alice
    return final == prize
end
grid = choice_vol_grid((:a, [1, 2, 3]), (:p, [1, 2, 3]), (:tie, [false, true]))
ANSWER = Dict(
  "stay"   => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(monty_deliberate, (false,), choicemap(), grid)),
  "switch" => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(monty_deliberate, (true,),  choicemap(), grid)),
)
